name: cambot_action_rules
text: CamBot top-level planning outputs TimelineScript JSON only. Use timeline actions such as base_longitudinal, base_rotate, lift_delta, checkpoint, follow_mode, and lighting_plan. Do not output motor payloads, raw arm commands, or stop actions.

name: framing_control_rules
text: For checkpoint and follow_mode, describe the target frame using bbox_format=cxcywh_norm and bbox=[cx, cy, w, h]. The lower visual-servo layer generates base/lift/arm correction actions; the top-level Agent only outputs expected_frame or target_frame plus servo permissions.

name: coordination_notes
text: Keep open-loop actions conservative. Use start_after for ordered actions, keep timeline ids unique, and always include a lighting_plan entry. Only follow_mode may be described as tracking or following.
